SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-09-30' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, CAST(SUM(oi.quantity) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC, segment LIMIT 1

WITH r AS (SELECT rg.id AS region_id, rg.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS rev_2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions rg ON rg.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-06' GROUP BY rg.id, rg.name) SELECT region_name FROM r WHERE rev_2024 IS NOT NULL AND rev_2024 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(rev_2025,0) - rev_2024) / rev_2024 ASC, region_name LIMIT 1
